note: ISA facts per architecture measured by tools/bench/isa_probe (isa_probe.cu, merged by isa_probe.py), in SM clocks: tensor pipe cycles per MMA at the SM and per partition, the dependent MMA latency, INT32 / FP32 cycles per warp instruction, dependent L1 / L2 / DRAM load latencies alone and under 2, 4, 8 chasing warps per SM, shared-memory latency.
